name: purewater
displayName: And Then the Dragons Came: Purewater
description: A Classic Fantasy Imperative campaign for mythras-gm. Purewater is a canal city where the Lake Lady's waters meet the sea, and Baron Hanzo di Teufel has arrived for the Tourney with a champion nobody is allowed to see. Three days before it all goes wrong. A living world: 15 agendas on clocks, 43 scheduled beats, 42 characters, and four playable entry points.
